name: monid-x402
description: Pre-sign spend gate for Monid's live x402 run host. inspect → policy → 402 → refuse or pay.

scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/reap-tmp-run.mjs --test dist/*.test.js fleet/worker.test.mjs
scripts.probe:live: npm run build && node dist/cli.js probe
scripts.refuse:live: npm run build && node dist/cli.js refuse --max-amount-micro 1
scripts.decision:live: npm run build && node dist/cli.js decision
scripts.catalog:live: npm run build && node dist/cli.js catalog --seeds evidence/seeds.json --out evidence/catalog-matrix.json
scripts.listen: npm run build && node dist/cli.js listen --port 8788
scripts.front: npm run build && node dist/cli.js front --port 8790
scripts.brief: npm run build && node dist/cli.js brief --domain canva.com
scripts.brief:pay: npm run build && node dist/cli.js brief --domain canva.com --confirm-spend --max-amount-micro 10000
scripts.index: npm run build && node dist/cli.js index
scripts.verify: npm run build && node dist/cli.js verify
scripts.retrieve:live: npm run build && node dist/cli.js retrieve
scripts.retrieve:sign: npm run build && node dist/cli.js retrieve --confirm-sign
scripts.e2e:listen: npm run build && node dist/cli.js e2e --base http://127.0.0.1:8788
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.quote:live: npm run build && node dist/cli.js product --url https://monid.ai

author: twzrd
